fact: The World Bank aide memoire for its 6-10 November 2024 mission says administrative data sources have been improved and used as GDP indicators for 2016-2023, ministries, agencies and commissions have been trained to improve administrative data collection and reporting, and the Ministry of Education is to get further training in 2025.
title: Liberia Implementation Support Mission (ISM) for the Harmonizing and Improving Statistics in West Africa Project (P169265) - Aide Memoire
